data.title: resolve_question — close a question with resolution text
data.summary: MCP tool _resolve_question(project, slug, question_id, resolution, by, expected_version). Sets resolved_at, resolved_by, resolution. Thin wrapper over resolve_in_list.

sections.body: Add _resolve_question(project, slug, question_id, resolution, by, expected_version) to reckon/mcp.py. Constructs updates = {resolved_at: utc_now, resolved_by: by, resolution: resolution}. Calls resolve_in_list(project, slug, 'questions', question_id, updates, expected_version). Returns {ok, project, slug, new_version} or _conflict_response or {ok: False, error: str(KeyError)}. Add ResolveQuestionArgs to reckon/_mcp_tools.py.

In tests/test_mcp_tools.py: test_resolve_question_happy_path (resolved_at + resolution set; other fields preserved), test_resolve_question_missing_id (ok=False with error string), test_resolve_question_version_conflict (stale version returns conflict response).
